# Confirm multiple reviewed resume entries keep edits paired correctly

## What & Why
The current review flow now uses each proposal ID to preserve the right supporting details, but coverage is limited to one synthetic project, role, and education entry. A multi-entry regression protects reviewers from one accepted edit inheriting another entry's bullets or details.

## Done looks like
- A synthetic resume with multiple projects, experience roles, and education entries can be reviewed in mixed accepted, edited, and rejected states.
- Each accepted or edited entry keeps its own proposal value and provenance.
- Rejected entries do not add their structured data or supporting details.
